rust_authorities: Rust now owns private client-supplied Discord voice preference validation, verified-owner-to-canonical SQL lookup, self-exclusion, full transactional replacement, capacities and current bilateral friend/preference/identity reads. No Python block/subject cache is authoritative. Rust also owns opt-in clan/party relay admission, actual native account bindings, accepted membership incarnations, opaque socket generations/replacement/retirement, version1 framing/sequence/burst rules, five-frame dropping queues, bounded media age and revalidated delivery. Native attachment/stream/queue effects publish after owned SQL commit; failure aborts the sealed plan. An expired commit plan rejects409 instead of exposing its staging envelope. Python retains socket handles, wake events, clock/provider/SQLite IO and transport deadlines. Four real red controls cover cache bypass, another SQL connection, premature outer commit and old clan membership reuse; current controls additionally cover queued blocks/replacement, upgrade revocation and failed COMMIT. These are modern private voice policies; no original Xbox codec, Live procedure or new unchanged-original execution is claimed. Canonical/provider verification, Steam upstream policy, complete Rust HTTP/service replacement, cross-store/process recovery and all original/native played/delivered gates remain open.

reproduced_gaps.after: Caller transaction remains open; rollback removes both marker and preference.

reproduced_gaps.after: The old incarnation closes; it cannot receive or send audio.
reproduced_gaps.scope: Persistent-state ownership control, not remote SQL access.
